description: This file defines a Java interface for a service related to collection sheet operations in the Fineract project. It declares methods for updating and saving individual collection sheets, using command objects and returning processing results.

classes.name: CollectionSheetWritePlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface defining methods for updating and saving collection sheet data, facilitating operations in the collection sheet module.

methods.name: updateCollectionSheet
methods.description: Updates a collection sheet based on the provided command object.

methods.name: saveIndividualCollectionSheet
methods.description: Saves an individual collection sheet based on the provided command object.
